key_insight: HiFi-Inpaint is a reference-based inpainting framework that preserves fine product details when generating human-product images by explicitly aligning and transferring high-frequency textures from product reference images into the inpainting pipeline.
problem_solved: Generates realistic human-product images while overcoming loss of product detail in conventional inpainting methods, enabling faithful reproduction of textures, patterns and logos from reference product images.
method: Reference-guided alignment: warp or attend to a product reference image to spatially align product appearance with the target human scene.
Multi-scale refinement and detail transfer: a coarse-to-fine generator that preserves high-frequency textures via specialized fusion blocks and detail-aware losses.
Training regime & objectives: combine perceptual/LPIPS-style metrics, high-frequency/texture-preserving loss terms, and adversarial refinement, trained on a diverse human-product dataset.
impact: Provides a practical solution for creating high-fidelity marketing and e-commerce images where product identity must be preserved, improving realism and trustworthiness for downstream visual applications and editing workflows.

paper_title: HiFi-Inpaint: Towards High-Fidelity Reference-Based Inpainting for Generating Detail-Preserving Human-Product Images
paper_authors: Yichen Liu, Donghao Zhou, Jie Wang, Xin Gao, Guisheng Liu
